title: External validation of an ECG AI model for left ventricular systolic dysfunction
summary: An existing AI model was applied to 42,291 ECG-echocardiography pairs from Heart Center Leipzig and gave an AUROC of 0.88, sensitivity 82% and specificity 77%. Patients without dysfunction but with a high model probability showed a higher probability at follow-up. This is a retrospective single-centre external validation of an existing model.
